source: Claude (Opus) scriptwriter, original idea; hook rotation #8, format rotation #4
title_working: Everyone Got A Future Card, Except Me
world_rule: Everyone gets a card that says what they will be. Except me.

lines.text: I was the only kid in my school whose future card came out blank.
lines.say: (sad) I was the only kid in my school whose future card came out blank.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Everyone gets one on their first day. It tells you what you will be.
lines.say: (confident) Everyone gets one on their first day. It tells you what you will be.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Zoe's card said doctor. Marcus got astronaut.
lines.say: (happy) Zoe's card said doctor. Marcus got astronaut.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Mine was empty. So they called me Nobody.
lines.say: (sad) Mine was empty. So they called me Nobody.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I tried everything. Painting, cooking, soccer. I was bad at all of it.
lines.say: (happy) I tried everything. Painting, cooking, soccer. I was bad at all of it.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Then a new kid, Ollie, opened his card. It was blank too. He started crying.
lines.say: (sad) Then a new kid, Ollie, opened his card. It was blank too. He started crying.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I sat next to him and said, blank just means nobody decided for you.
lines.say: (soft tone) I sat next to him and said, blank just means nobody decided for you.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: That night, my card finally printed one word. Teacher.
lines.say: (happy) That night, my card finally printed one word. Teacher.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Blank cards wait until you do the thing you were born for.
lines.say: (confident) Blank cards wait until you do the thing you were born for.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Now I help the new kids open their cards. And this morning, one came out blank.
lines.say: (soft tone) Now I help the new kids open their cards. And this morning, one came out blank.
lines.speaker: narrator
